skill.summary: Provides detailed insights into Colgate-Palmolive's 225-year history, global oral care market dominance, business model, and emerging market strategies.

Colgate-Palmoral Skill v1.0.0 Changelog

- 首次发布，介绍 Colgate 从创立到成为全球口腔护理领导者的历史和商业模式
